title: Guard _bindObserver's post-await 'state =' write with ref.mounted in preference_providers.dart
rule: SM-4 (check ref.mounted after any await in a Notifier method/async callback before touching state)
why: _bindObserver's pref.read(profileId).then(onValue) sets state after an unguarded await, with no ref.mounted check, inside a callback registered from build() by all 5 keepAlive preference notifiers. Per SM-4 this should no-op if the provider was disposed while the read was in flight (e.g. a test that builds one of these notifiers in a ProviderContainer and disposes the container immediately). Confirm by: build UseHebrewDate/ShowNikudPref/etc. in a ProviderContainer, dispose the container synchronously right after first read, and check whether an unhandled exception surfaces from the pending pref.read().then() callback.
recommendation: Add 'if (!ref.mounted) return;' at the top of the onValue callback inside _bindObserver, before 'if (value != state) state = value;'.
acceptance_criteria: _bindObserver's onValue callback no-ops when ref.mounted is false.
A test that disposes a ProviderContainer immediately after building one of the 5 keepAlive notifiers passes with no unhandled exception.

corrections: Standard's cited rationale (coding-standards.md:145) is specifically autoDispose teardown, not keepAlive — narrows real-world reachability but doesn't invalidate the concern given the already-low SUSPECTED/P3 rating.
